name: OkCredit
long_description:
Today, over 50 million SMBs issue informal credit in India, This is a hugely manual process which they spend hours tracking, reconciling, and collecting! 

The 50M SMBs in India account for 40% of the nation’s GDP. As much as 60% of their sales happen on credit. That’s ~24% of the country’s GDP (500B$) lying on paper!

OKCREDIT as a company came into existence to start solving the most important problem of credit recovery in MSMEs. We as first movers developed a bookkeeping app that would help any merchant sitting at the remotest corner of the country with internet connectivity to record his transactions digitally. We helped them track the credit given to their customers and suppliers. With our Okcredit app a merchant can track the amount of credit given, monitor credit limit, send reminders and eventually can collect faster from their customers. So as a company our vision was to bring the data dark merchants onto the digital platform. We have changed the way the MSMEs record the transactions and eased their life today.
one_liner: Simple and secure bookkeeping for Indian businesses.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: 1. Recovery of credit - MSMEs businesses run on a credit system. To run their business and sustain in the market they need to provide goods/services on credit, but recovery of this credit is the key challenge. 2. Working capital for the business - It’s difficult to get credit at a cheaper rate, you need to prove your credit worthiness to secure loans or provide collaterals to get loans.Most of the MSMEs are unserved, unidentified and underserved segments in an economy like India.3. Demand for customers - Due to the booming e-commerce market and pandemic situation , there is a paradigm shift in the purchasing habits. Most of the customer base has moved towards online purchases/transactions. Traditional merchants are facing tough competition to convert these customers.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: In 2019 I took over the family business, a 20 year old full service car wash. This business had no subscription program, which by this point had become a popular thing in the car wash industry. The site was also surrounded by several well established competitors.\\Instead of offering an identical subscription model that gave customers a single wash unlimited I wanted to do something different. Our subscription gave customers more flexibility and combined multiple packages from our menu, allowing them to both clean the car themselves and take advantage of options where we cleaned the car for them all for a recurring monthly fee.\\I searched the industry for a solution that would help me do this and found none. All existing solutions were inflexible and came with quotes over $100K. This wasn’t going to work for us, so I built a custom solution and shortly after other car washes were interested in using it as well.

launches.title: 🚘💦FlexWash - An operating system for car washes
launches.tagline: We make all the software car washes need to manage operations and revenue.
launches.body:
Hi, we’re [Chirag](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/165993) and [Karan](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/968288), founders of [Flex Wash](https://www.flexwashtech.com/), based in Temecula CA. We have decades of software development experience and ran a car wash ourselves.

**Flex Wash is an operating system for the car wash industry. We help owners manage their operations and grow their revenue.**

Car washing is an industry no one ever thinks about, especially software companies. But they should! This is a $15B industry that is rapidly evolving with publicly traded companies and franchises entering the space for the first time in history.

### **The Problem**

Car washes have complex technology needs beyond just normal retail

* 🚗 License plate recognition and tracking
* 💰 Monthly subscription management
* 🧑 Customer retargeting
* ⚙️ Complex maintenance for equipment that costs up to $1M

Current solutions in this space are

* 💲 Costly, charge big upfront fees for custom hardware (up to $100K)
* 📟 Out of date, require ancient versions of Windows on-premise servers
* 🩼 Inflexible, software is sold in static licenses rather than as a service

### **The Solution**

We offer car wash operators a system that is:

* 😺 Affordable, just a monthly SaaS fee
* 📱 Compatible with generic hardware (< $700)
* ☁️ Runs in the cloud, operators can focus on car washing, not servers
* 💰 Modern, we use vehicle wash history to funnel customers to high-margin subscriptions

### We know this because we ran a car wash ourselves. We faced these issues first hand and that is why we got together to build FlexWash. Our solution not only saves operators money but helps them better manage operations and boost revenue.

\
**The Ask**

* **Own a car wash? … We’d love to give you a demo**
* **Don’t own a car wash? … Refer anyone in your network, especially your favorite car wash, please.**
* **Car wash enthusiast? … We’d love to chat.**

Reach us at [karan@flexwashtech.com](mailto:karan@flexwashtech.com).

launches.body:
**tl;dr**: We make sure small businesses never miss out on potential customers because of missed calls. We use conversational AI to engage customers over text, find out what they need, and book them for a service.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74112&key=user_uploads/406208/e4650e95-528b-4a3f-97ed-babcf0965a2f)

We’re Divyesh, Omar, and Anand, and we’re building [Twine](https://www.usetwine.com/).

# **Problem: Missed Calls = Missed Business** 💸

Small businesses are missing out on thousands of dollars because they can’t immediately pick up the phone. Customers often work with the company that responds to them the fastest. To solve the problem of missed calls, businesses employ expensive solutions, such as a receptionist or an outsourced answering service.

# **Solution: Missed Calls** ☎️ **→ Immediate AI Text Message Conversations** 💬

If a business misses a call, Twine texts the customer to find out why they were calling and can get them on their calendar. We integrate with existing VOIP and cell phone services with minimal setup time.

### **How we got started**

Anand started a networking & audio/visual company in high school that eventually grew to six figures. He sold phone systems to small businesses and saw the revenue his customers left on the table due to missed calls.

# **The Ask** 👋

Do you know a small business owner that could benefit from Twine? If so, we'd be grateful for an introduction!

launches.tagline: Meet malibou, the first all-in-one payroll and HR software for French SMBs
launches.body:
\[**tl;dr**\] French payroll is so complex that no one has been able to build the Justwork or Gusto for France. This is coming to an end— we’re building the first all-in-one payroll and HR software for every French startup and SMB.

Hey y’all, we’re Max and Alex, the team behind [malibou](https://www.malibou.co/). We’re here to fix French payroll.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79030&key=user_uploads/89898/9981454f-3181-4baa-b681-a0fb9d76168d)

**❌ The problem**

Running payroll in France is tough! There are 800 different labor agreements with its own set of rules, and each company belongs to a different one.

So when processing payroll in France, you either have the choice between

1/ an accountant with good advice but no way to connect a good HRIS with him. Everything is manual (excel file, emails…)

2/ a good HRIS that does not include payroll services— no one wants to deal with French payroll

**✅ The solution**

Malibou is the first all-in-one payroll and HR software for every French startup and SMB.

Our promise is the following: 1/ We provide best-in-class HRIS designed for local compliance and 2/ We provide expert help so that HR managers and CEOs don’t have to deal with bureaucracy.

Thanks to malibou, companies can manage employee repositories, onboard newcomers in a few clicks, accept leave requests, validate and distribute payslips, pay their team from the app, and ask any questions related to social laws to our experts. Employees benefit from direct access to malibou.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79030&key=user_uploads/1585512/bc7eac7b-0867-422b-b423-d459248f6c2d)

**👥 The team**

[**Max**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxence-drummond-485057b4/) and [**Alex**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexandre-pernin-602308a3/) here, originally from France 🇫🇷.

Max was a VC partner at Breega, where he opened the London office.

Alex is a software engineer and also an ex-YC founder.

**🙏 Ask: How you can help**

* Share this with anyone you know who is employing people in France

launches.title: OffDeal -  AI broker for buying small businesses
launches.tagline: Custom-built AI agents to find, vet, and engage SMB acquisition targets
launches.body:
Howdy folks 👋🏻 We’re [Ori](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eldarov/) and [Alston](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alstonlin/) from [OffDeal](http://www.offdeal.io) and we’re building an AI broker that helps individual buyers find and acquire small businesses. 

# tl;dr

Finding the right small business to acquire is painfully manual and tedious - an average buyer takes almost two years to buy one! 🫨

OffDeal puts SMB deal sourcing on autopilot. Our AI broker

* Screens through millions of SMBs using semantic search on dozens of data points to identify potential targets 
* Automatically researches each one to ensure criteria match using custom AI web agents
* Crafts and sends hyper-personalized emails to maximize response rate

Since launching our closed beta two weeks ago, we have about a dozen buyers using OffDeal to source $10-50 million SMB acquisitions.

# **❌ Problem: Buying a small business takes 18-24 months**

The current process of finding a small business to buy is painstakingly slow and tedious. Today, buyers rely on a combination of expensive SMB databases (e.g. Grata, Sourcescrub) and manual research, often involving a makeshift "deal team" of unpaid interns and offshore assistants. 

This cobbled-together system creates a major bottleneck, typically allowing buyers to only assess 100-150 businesses per week (and that's considered good!). Since buyers usually need to go through \~10,000 businesses before finding “the one”, the entire process becomes incredibly time-consuming, frustrating, and expensive.

## **✨ Our Solution: AI Broker to find, diligence, and engage 10x more SMB targets**

Our AI broker acts much like a human M&A advisor would - it finds targets, diligences them, and then reaches out to them on your behalf. However, unlike a human, our AI broker is powered by proprietary recommendation engines and custom-built AI agents and can do this for thousands of companies at a time 👀

Here is how it works:

**Step 1.** 🔎**Preliminary target list** 

Our AI screens through millions of SMBs on dozens of data points using LLM-powered semantic search to uncover off-market hidden gems that match your exact acquisition criteria.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79184&key=user_uploads/1297689/3137a403-b062-4ac1-a4ac-d6f626df2c51)

**Step 2. 🧠 Offload tedious research**

Our web-enabled AI agents conduct automated diligence, vetting thousands of companies to deliver a precision-targeted shortlist in minutes, not days.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79184&key=user_uploads/1297689/b2aae969-b311-4a27-80f3-1be6afde6f4b)

**Step 3.⚡Automate personalized outreach**

Our AI uses dozens of data points to craft and send hundreds of hyper-personalized messages each week, helping you stand out from other buyers and fill your calendar with owner calls.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79184&key=user_uploads/1297689/e224acfd-e6f7-459c-b4f3-81b2933cbb57)

# **Our first customers**

To start we’re focusing on “search funds”. These are individuals (typically MBAs from top programs) who raise money from institutional investors to acquire a small business.

This is an ideal first customer because: 

1. They only have 2 years to find a business (or have to return capital)
2. 30% of searchers fail to find a deal within that timeframe
3. They are happy to pay finder fees for successful introductions
4. Ori personally knows dozens of them from his time at HBS and working in finance, making for a much easier GTM 🙂

Beyond search funds, we plan to expand to private equity firms, which buy thousands of SMBs each year, as well as to a rapidly growing number of individuals choosing to leave the rat race and pursue acquisition entrepreneurship.

# 

# 🤝🏻**Team**

[Ori Eldarov](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eldarov/) (CEO) first came across this problem in 2019 - when he attempted (unsuccessfully) to acquire a business. A couple of years later, he saw dozens of his classmates at HBS go through the same struggles. 

[Alston Lin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alstonlin/) (CTO) also struggled to find the right SMBs in the previous startup he founded - using existing tools that relied on broad industry buckets resulted in most outreach going to irrelevant businesses. However, with his experience working with big data and ranking engines at Facebook and Google, he knew he could build a better solution.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79184&key=user_uploads/1297689/e260dfb2-5b95-467d-8d5d-e61094feec02)

# **The Ask**

If you or anyone you know is looking to acquire a small business ($10-50M) please introduce us! We can be reached at [founders@offdeal.io](mailto:founders@offdeal.io) or this [form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScyDLNDz41cP1l404c8ESodrN0lCDM7_HgfOBS2BC2x5F64EA/viewform). 

These can be any of the following: 

* Individual buyers / “search funds” 
* Lower middle market PE firms 
* Companies looking to make an add-on acquisition

 

**Thanks everyone for your support 🙂**

Every OpenClaw today is an intern with root access and no oversight. ☠️🏴‍☠️

**So we built the first one that has a boss.** 🦞

Diana is a business-ready OpenClaw with a Governor monitoring every action - that can shut it down mid-task, before damage is done. 

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sdka6JW9QK0>

**TL;DR:**

**🛡** Diana is a business-ready OpenClaw with a Governor monitoring every action

**⚡** Connect 3,000+ tools via API, or log into any app via Browser Logins

**🔒** Per-user credential isolation. Every employee gets their own sandboxed agent

**🏗** Built by engineers from Google, Gusto, MIT, CMU, and Yale

## **The Governor**

Here's the thing about OpenClaw: it talks directly to your tools. Slack, Notion, your APIs. No filter. No oversight. If it hallucinates or gets prompt-injected, it acts on your systems before anyone can stop it.

**Diana never talks to Slack, Notion, or your APIs directly.**

Every action routes through the Governor first. It checks intent, filters output, and watches for drift in real-time. If something is off, the Governor kills the action before it reaches your systems. Not after. Before.

The architecture:

→ Slack ingress hits the Governor (trust boundary)

→ Governor routes to isolated agent sandboxes

→ Agent has zero DB access, zero secrets

→ Every LLM and tool call goes back through the Governor

→ Governor filters output before it reaches Slack

## **3,000+ Integrations + Browser Logins**

Diana connects to Slack, Google Workspace, HubSpot, Stripe, Notion, Linear, GitHub, and thousands more via API.

**And if there is no API? Diana logs in with a browser, just like you would.**

HRIS portals, benefits platforms, 401k providers, state registration websites. If you can click it, Diana can work it. All through the Governor.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99731&key=user_uploads/128506/e04c3454-71cc-4c21-a942-3ba81aa51cd3)

## **Give Your Employee Their Own Employee**

Don't replace your team. Give them superpowers.

Diana is simple to install and use: Install to Slack → connect your tools → **just ask**:

**_→_** _"Show me our Hubspot pipeline by stage and expected close date"_

**_→_** _"Build me a revenue dashboard in Google Sheets for our March Investor Update. Send me a revenue dashboard every month."_

**_→_** _"Review these 5 invoices against the tracking spreadsheet let me know if there are any discrepancies"_

**_→_** _"Every Monday at 9am, send me a summary of the #general Slack channel from last week"_

**_→_** _"Onboard Sarah Chen as Senior PM into HRIS Payroll. Here’s the offer letter."_

**Diana works across finance, operations, sales, product, engineering, marketing, and HR. Built for every employee on earth. Hire humans, and help them to 10x.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99731&key=user_uploads/128506/48d04c0d-9f5e-4983-80a5-d3a5382d8eb3)

## **The Backstory**

Before Diana, we built DianaHR, a fractional HR service for SMBs. Running that business, we saw firsthand how much time operations teams waste on repetitive tasks: onboarding new hires into HRIS systems, chasing unsigned documents, answering the same benefits questions, filing state registrations.

When OpenClaw exploded, we saw the opportunity: an AI agent that could actually do this work. But the security gaps were a dealbreaker for business use. So we built a Governor on top, added per-user credential isolation, and created Browser Logins so Diana could work with tools that don't have APIs.

Backed by Y Combinator (W24), General Catalyst, and SNR Ventures. Built by a team from Google, Gusto, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, and Amazon.

**And this is just the start. Our goal is an AI employee so trusted you can hand it an entire business function and let it run.**

## **Our Asks**

**Try Diana for free.** If you want an OpenClaw agent AND peace of mind: [**getdiana.com**](http://getdiana.com)

For YC founders we are giving one month free of our assistant tier. Ping me on Bookface or email for a code!

**Feedback.** If you try Diana and something breaks or feels off, tell us. DM me on Slack, email [upeka@getdiana.com](mailto:upeka@getdiana.com), or find me on X at @upekabee

Let's go. 💚

Boom reaches out to your customers before you lose them.

We run proactive outbound conversations at scale: recovering churned users, re-engaging drop-offs, and protecting revenue you thought was gone. AI agents hold real conversations with your customers over SMS, email, WhatsApp, or phone, in their language, on the channel they actually answer.

Every month, companies lose 5-15% of revenue to churn, and more walks out through abandoned signups and failed onboarding. The tools built to fix this don't work. Win-back emails get ignored. Cancel flows only catch people at the door. Hiring humans doesn't scale. Boom does the one thing that works: a real conversation. 1,000x the reach of manual outreach, and the customer can reply.

launches.title: TryNearby: Every local business needs to be discoverable. That $150B market is moving toward local creators.
launches.tagline: Word of mouth at scale for local restaurants
launches.body:
Hey everyone,

We're Yousef, Obaida, and Ahmad, the founders of **TryNearby**.

Yousef co-founded FaZe Clan and spent 15 years creating content for 10M+ followers alongside hundreds of other creators. Ahmad and Obaida co-founded one of the first social media clipping companies, building the infrastructure that tracked billions of views across thousands of videos for creator campaigns. We've watched creator content become the most powerful distribution channel on the internet, and we're bringing it to local businesses.

## **TL;DR**

84% of small businesses on TikTok say it helped grow their business. Almost every restaurant owner we meet knows that and has no idea how to act on it.

TryNearby handles it. Every month we send a new group of creators who live nearby to visit, film, and post a review, for a $399 subscription. All of it is handled by us and our AI agents.

Today, 120+ restaurants are subscribed and have had 2,500+ videos posted for them. We nearly doubled one restaurant's revenue in their first month, and owners tell us people walk in every day saying "we saw you on TikTok." Almost half our new restaurants now come from other owners referring us.

Our launch video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lSG0v1MNwik>

## **The problem**

There are about 1 million restaurants and cafes in the US. Most of them are invisible in the places people actually decide where to eat.

The options an owner has today:

* Agencies cost thousands a month and often don’t drive real results
* Influencers work, but finding the right local ones, negotiating, and doing it again every month is a job by itself
* Creating their own content is a second full-time job they don't have time for, or a full-time hire they don't have the budget for

And here's the thing: _the algorithm doesn't reward a business talking about itself. It rewards people talking about the business._

So the thing that actually works — someone who lives nearby posting about your food — happens once or twice, or not at all.

And the platforms keep rewarding the ones who show up. TikTok's new Local Feed ranks by location and recency, so the restaurants getting fresh content every month reach their own neighborhood. The ones who don't, disappear.

## **The solution**

TryNearby is a subscription that puts local creators inside local restaurants every month, and their followers through the door.

$399/month. Every month we automatically schedule a new group of vetted creators who live nearby. They come in, film, edit, and post. The restaurant just serves the food.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/7721f4f4-96e4-4a68-b860-841fee782765)

### **Part 1 — They sign up, creators start showing up**

The moment a restaurant joins, our matching agent finds the creators nearby who fit that spot and sends the invites. Sometimes a creator is scheduled to visit within five minutes of a restaurant signing up. Creators pick their own time from the restaurant's availability. The restaurant doesn't coordinate anything or answer a single message.

### **Part 2 — An AI agent runs every creator relationship**

Every creator on TryNearby is managed over iMessage by an agent we built. Onboarding, match invites, booking, reminders, reschedules, questions. It handles over 10,000 texts a month.

It also learns as it goes. Every conversation teaches it more about that creator: what they like to eat, where they'll actually drive, when they're free, what they turn down. That context feeds the matching, so the invites get better the longer someone is on the platform.

For creators, it's a personal assistant that helps them become better creators while bringing collaborations straight to their iMessage instead of them chasing restaurants.

### **Part 3 — Restaurant owners get their own AI agent to text**

Owners get an assistant in iMessage too. It watches every video, comment, and review, and tells them what's happening: who's visiting this week, how the last video performed, what people are saying. So when a dish sells out the week after a creator posted about it, the owner knows exactly why.

Our team sits behind both agents. Anything either one can't handle gets flagged to us in seconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/5ff964f8-9013-42d7-9617-29d6ccb2164a)

## **Traction**

10 months in:

* 120+ paying restaurants across Southern California
* 37% month-over-month growth with over 90% monthly restaurant retention since November
* 2,500+ videos posted by local creators → \~35M views, almost entirely from people within a few miles

What that turned into for the restaurants:

* A restaurant in San Diego nearly doubled revenue in a single month
* Another had a whole new demographic of customers drive a 50% increase in sales
* Dishes featured in creator videos hit record sales the following week

Every single owner tells us the same thing: **people are walking in and saying they saw them on TikTok.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/3301e743-2fef-43c4-9138-aaa5631d1eb8)

## **Team**

**Yousef** co-founded FaZe Clan after starting as a 14-year-old YouTuber in 2010. He spent 15 years in the creator economy, built an audience of 10M+ followers and over a billion views, and helped take FaZe public on the Nasdaq at a $1B valuation.

**Ahmad** co-founded one of the first social media clipping companies, where he built the first and largest infrastructure for short-form clipping, tracking 10B+ views across tens of thousands of videos for some of the biggest creators on the internet. UC Berkeley CS, previously a senior engineer at WeightWatchers.

**Obaida** co-founded the clipping company alongside Ahmad. He was an early employee at Replit, previously Goldman Sachs, and grew a consumer app from $360K to $2M ARR in 18 months. Master's in applied economics from Johns Hopkins.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/031126b7-4cbd-49dc-989f-ef79381b8bd9)

If you own a restaurant, know an owner who wants more foot traffic, are a local creator, or are just interested in TryNearby, we'd love to talk → 📧 [hello@trynearby.com](https://mailto:hello@trynearby.com)
